note: Eight development scans visually reviewed. Printed wording transcribed; soft wraps are not forced. Poetry line breaks are intentional. Land targets retain semantic subtypes and require an actual historical printing policy. Expected alignment/artist are review targets, not geometry overrides. Heldouts remain unviewed.

386ea9eb-abc1-4862-aa2d-8fb808d79490.name: Swords to Plowshares
386ea9eb-abc1-4862-aa2d-8fb808d79490.rulesText: Target creature is removed from game entirely; return to owner’s deck only when game is over. Creature’s controller gains life points equal to creature’s power.

a6a86e6e-bfff-46af-9d36-c912901fea92.name: Psionic Blast
a6a86e6e-bfff-46af-9d36-c912901fea92.rulesText: Psionic Blast does 4 damage to any target, but it does 2 damage to you as well.
a6a86e6e-bfff-46af-9d36-c912901fea92.artistReviewNote: Printed Schuler spelling verified in the development scan. Canonical artist metadata retains Shuler; this partial review does not certify other fields.

6701874e-986e-4b81-9268-90b6171e6187.name: Bog Wraith
6701874e-986e-4b81-9268-90b6171e6187.flavorText:
’Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae
My mate did meet an early grave
’Twas nothing left for us to save
In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

b21ebc9f-a93e-4d18-b3e8-8459e3abbf31.name: Tunnel
b21ebc9f-a93e-4d18-b3e8-8459e3abbf31.rulesText: Destroys 1 wall. Target wall cannot be regenerated.

8df80424-3bd9-4982-ad79-e55d9ba3b43d.name: Wall of Wood
8df80424-3bd9-4982-ad79-e55d9ba3b43d.flavorText: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it’s better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

2b814198-814b-4619-a158-327af675f8f2.name: Soul Net
2b814198-814b-4619-a158-327af675f8f2.rulesText: {1}: You gain 1 life every time a creature is destroyed, unless it is then regenerated.

6eafa00b-c628-40f6-86eb-88e1361fc7a0.name: Plateau
6eafa00b-c628-40f6-86eb-88e1361fc7a0.expectedRulesText: Counts as both mountains and plains and is affected by spells that affect either. Tap to add either {R} or {W} to your mana pool.

bc6ea08d-7991-4a57-a1e3-abd508426970.name: Island
bc6ea08d-7991-4a57-a1e3-abd508426970.expectedRulesText: Tap to add {U} to your mana pool.
